posts.title: Estimate your BAC, now 100% in the browser
posts.description: Thanks to the awesomeness of webR and Shinylive , the tool I made in back in 2014 to estimate your blood alcohol concentration (BAC) now runs 100% in the browser, no server needed! Try the browser version of drinkR here!
